newsitem.title: USA: Coastal board approves Texas ammonia plant.
newsitem.headline: Coastal board approves Texas ammonia plant.

text.p: Coastal Corp said its subsidiary Coastal Refining & Marketing Inc had received approval from Coastal's board of directors to build an ammonia plant near Freeport, Texas.
Coastal said it had bought the plant from Dakota Gasification Co in April and moved it to Texas City, Texas, from its original site at Plaquemine, Louisiana, where it had been in storage.
Once installed at Freeport, the plant will produce 660 tonnes per day of anhydrous ammonia, to be marketed to industrial customers in the local area, it said.

Coastal also said it had awarded Air Liquide America Corp of French Air Liquide Group to supply it with nitrogen and hydrogen feedstocks. Air Liquide will build a new hydrogen purification facility near the plant to produce up to 45 million standard cubic feet of hydrogen per day.
Both the ammonia plant and the hydrogen plant are expected to be fully operational in November 1997, it added.
Coastal is an energy holding company.
